'''Tim Peterson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Clint Hays's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1181">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-30-gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizzd1181/ gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizz], DeckTech (Clint "GameMaster" Hays, 30 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-30-gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizzd1181/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
